about: The set of pictures for the Illustrated theme. Each image has an id and the passages it sits behind. The narrowest passage covering a card wins, so a book picture is the default and a moment overrides it. 'prompt' is the subject only: the Worker (src/art.js) puts 'style' in front of it and paints the picture the first time it is asked for. 'pilot' marks the ones worth looking at first to judge the style.
style: Painterly storybook illustration in soft gouache and watercolor, with visible brushwork and a little paper grain. Warm, muted earth palette (ochre, terracotta, olive, dusty rose, deep indigo and slate) with gentle glowing light. Low contrast, with no pure black and no pure white. One clear focal point in the upper half and calmer, simpler shapes below, because verse text will sit over the picture. People are simplified and stylized, seen from behind, from a distance or in soft silhouette, with no detailed facial features, and look Middle Eastern, in plain first-century or ancient Near Eastern clothing. Architecture and landscape are period-accurate. God is never drawn as a person: use light, cloud, fire or wind. Reverent and restrained, nothing graphic or frightening. No text, letters, numbers, writing, symbols that look like writing, logos, watermarks or borders. Tall vertical portrait composition (2:3).
